binding.rule: B-3, H-7: a value that is no path is refused by the binding with invalid_path before the core, whose argument is a path

multipart.label: a multipart/form-data type whose boundary is a quoted string of no character fails with no_boundary (400)
a multipart/form-data type without a boundary parameter fails with no_boundary (400)
a Content-Disposition parameter that is a quoted string without its end fails the body with invalid (400)
a filename that is a quoted string without its end fails the body with invalid (400)
a boundary that is a quoted string without its end fails with malformed_content_type (400)
any parameter of a multipart/form-data type that is a quoted string without its end fails with malformed_content_type (400)
header lines of 8193 bytes from the end of the delimiter line to the empty line fail with header_limit (400)
a part whose header lines do not end within 8192 bytes fails with header_limit (400)
a file part whose filename has a byte that is not UTF-8 fails the body with invalid (400), read whole, byte by byte and in two chunks divided anywhere
a value whose content ends inside a UTF-8 sequence fails with invalid (400)
a line feed after the media type is no whitespace of a field value, so the Content-Type fails with malformed_content_type (400)
an empty Content-Type is no media type and fails with malformed_content_type (400); a request without Content-Type has no values
a space before the media type is no part of the field value, so the body is urlencoded
a space before the media type is no part of the field value, so the body is multipart with its boundary
the byte A0, a no-break space, is no whitespace of a field value, so the Content-Type fails with malformed_content_type (400)
the byte A0 before a parameter is no whitespace, so the Content-Type fails with malformed_content_type (400)
the byte C0 (À) is no token character, so a subtype that holds it fails with malformed_content_type (400)
the byte C0 (À) is obs-text, which a quoted string carries, so it is part of the boundary
a quoted parameter value without its end fails the Content-Type of an urlencoded body with malformed_content_type (400)
a parameter given twice fails the Content-Type with malformed_content_type (400), the same boundary too
a backslash in a quoted boundary quotes the byte after it, which is part of the boundary without the backslash
the charset of an urlencoded type changes nothing: the body is read as UTF-8
a part whose Content-Disposition has no name parameter fails the body with invalid (400)
a no-break space separates nothing, so the part has no name parameter and fails the body with invalid (400)
a part whose disposition type is not form-data fails the body with invalid (400)
a lone carriage return ends no header line, so the part has no Content-Disposition and fails the body with invalid (400)
a part without header lines has no Content-Disposition and fails the body with invalid (400)
a Content-Disposition that gives the parameter name twice fails the body with invalid (400)
a disposition type that only starts with form-data is another type and fails the body with invalid (400)
a multipart body held as one value with a part of another disposition type fails with invalid (400) when it is read
parameter names compare without case, so name and NAME are one parameter given twice and fail the body with invalid (400)
a filename given twice fails the body with invalid (400), also with the same value
filename* is not read: a part with it and without filename is a value
a part without a name fails the body, also after a value that was read
header lines of other names change nothing
a part with two Content-Disposition lines fails the body with invalid (400): no rule says which one counts
two Content-Disposition lines fail the body with invalid (400) also when their values are equal, and a header name compares without case
the urlencoded type defines no parameter, so a parameter other than charset changes nothing either
a file part with two Content-Type lines fails the body with invalid (400): no rule says which one counts
a header line without a colon is no header field and fails the body with invalid (400)

content_type.label: mediaType() returns the media type of Content-Type in lower case, without its parameters and the spaces around it
mediaType() of a request without Content-Type is the empty text
the media type of a multipart type is without its parameters, and the boundary is the value of its parameter
the media type of a type that is no form type is its type and subtype in lower case
spaces and tabs around the value are no part of the media type
the byte A0 before the media type fails mediaType() with malformed_content_type (400)
the byte C0 (À) in a type fails mediaType() with malformed_content_type (400)
a quoted parameter value without its end fails mediaType() with malformed_content_type (400)
the empty Content-Type is no media type, unlike a request without Content-Type

boundary.label: multipart/form-data without a boundary parameter fails multipartBoundary() with no_boundary (400)
an empty boundary parameter fails multipartBoundary() with no_boundary (400)

held.label: a multipart body held as one value within its part and file limits gives its values and files
a multipart body held as one value with more parts than the part limit fails with part_limit (413)
a file of a multipart body held as one value with more bytes than the file limit fails with file_limit (413)
a body held as one value with more bytes than the value limit fails with value_limit (413)
a held body that passes the body limit and the value limit at one byte fails with body_limit (413)
the part limit bounds the parts of a multipart body, not the pairs of an urlencoded body
a held body whose Content-Type starts with the byte A0 fails with malformed_content_type (400)
a held multipart body without a boundary fails with no_boundary (400)
a held urlencoded value that is not UTF-8 fails with invalid (400)
a held multipart part whose header passes the header limit fails with header_limit (400)

file_over.label: file_over is true for the limit 5 when the largest file has 6 bytes
file_over is false for the limit 6 when the largest file has 6 bytes
file_over is false for the limit 7 when the largest file has 6 bytes
file_over is false for no files, also for the limit 0

file_over_binding.label: a negative limit is no uint and fails with invalid_number, also for a body without files

request_body.start.label: a Content-Length above the body limit fails with body_limit before a byte is read
a Content-Length of more digits than 64 bits hold is above any limit
a Content-Length that is not one or more digits fails with invalid_content_length (RFC 9110 8.6)
a Content-Length list of the same number is not one number and fails with invalid_content_length
a body read in chunks whose type has no boundary fails with no_boundary before a byte is read
a body read in chunks whose type has a quoted parameter without its end fails with malformed_content_type
a body read in chunks whose directory the system does not create fails with the failure of the system, io with its errno (F-10)
a body read in chunks whose directory the system does not create fails with the failure of the system, not_found with its errno ENOENT, the kind of a path that does not exist (F-10)
a body read in chunks whose directory the system does not create fails with the failure of the system, permission_denied with its errno EACCES, the kind of a refused access (F-10)
a body read in chunks whose directory the system does not create fails with the failure of the system, storage_full with its errno ENOSPC, the kind of a full storage (F-10)

request_body.feed.label: a value byte that is not UTF-8 before the body limit is the first failure, also when one chunk passes the limit
a body whose bytes before the limit are valid fails with body_limit at the byte after the limit
a byte that passes the value limit and is not UTF-8 fails with value_limit: at one byte a limit comes before F-21.5
a byte that is not UTF-8 before the byte past the value limit fails with invalid
the byte past the value limit comes before the byte that is not UTF-8
the CR LF after ab may start a delimiter, so it passes the value limit at Q, the byte after the body limit: the failure is body_limit
with Q within the body limit, the CR after ab passes the value limit
a delimiter followed by x fails at x, which is within the body limit
a part counts at the CR LF after its delimiter, before its header lines
header lines of 8193 bytes fail with header_limit in every division
a body held as one value fails at the byte past the value limit when that comes first
a body held as one value that passes both limits at one byte fails with body_limit
a streamed file part whose filename is not UTF-8 fails with invalid in every division
a part of another disposition type within the part limit fails the streamed body with invalid (400) at the end of its header lines
a part of another disposition type fails the body with invalid (400) at the end of its header lines, before the third part passes the part limit
a part that gives its name twice has no name, so it fails with invalid (400) and not with the value limit that a name would pass
a part without Content-Disposition fails the streamed body with invalid (400) at the end of its header lines, in every division
a streamed file part with more bytes than the file limit fails with file_limit (413)
a file part whose new file the system does not create fails the chunk with the failure of the system, io with its errno (F-10)
a file part whose new file the system does not create fails the chunk with the failure of the system, not_found with its errno ENOENT, the kind of a path that does not exist (F-10)
a file part whose new file the system does not create fails the chunk with the failure of the system, permission_denied with its errno EACCES, the kind of a refused access (F-10)
a file part whose new file the system does not create fails the chunk with the failure of the system, storage_full with its errno ENOSPC, the kind of a full storage (F-10)
a write of the content of a file part that the system fails fails the chunk with io and its errno (F-10)
a write that writes fewer bytes than it was given is found by the size of the file and fails with io without errno (F-15)
a written file whose size the system does not give fails the chunk with io and its errno (F-15)

request_body.finish.label: a streamed multipart body that ends before its first delimiter fails at finish with invalid (400)

request_body.parts.label: parts() of a streamed body before finish fails with not_finished
parts() of a body held as one value fails with not_streamed

request_body.properties.label: a new streamed body holds no bytes, has the size 0 and is streamed
a new body held as one value holds no bytes and has no directory

body.label: a Content-Length equal to the body limit reads the body
a body that ends before its closing delimiter fails with invalid when the host ends it
parts() before finish() fails with not_finished
parts() of a body held as one value fails with not_streamed
content() and moveTo() of a stored file fail with removed after the directory of the request was removed
a multipart body that is one value is held whole: the part and file limits bound it when it is read (F-25.6), not while it is held

request_body.feed.made.label: a chunk given to a streamed body after its finish fails with finished (F-9)
a chunk given to a streamed body after its removal fails with removed (F-10)

request_body.finish.made.label: the finish of a streamed body after its removal fails with removed (F-10)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed with header_limit, header lines of a part longer than 8192 bytes (F-23.4), gives that first failure again (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed with body_limit, a body past the body limit of 16 bytes (F-25.1), gives that first failure again (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed with value_limit, a value past the value limit of 1 byte (F-25.2), gives that first failure again (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed with part_limit, a second part past the part limit of 1 (F-25.3), gives that first failure again (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed with file_limit, a file past the file limit of 1 byte (F-25.4), gives that first failure again (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with ENOENT, the kind not_found of a path that does not exist (F-10), gives that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with EACCES, the kind permission_denied of a refused access (F-10), gives that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with ENOSPC, the kind storage_full of a full storage (F-10), gives that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the finish of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with EIO, the kind io of a failure of the system (F-10), gives that first failure again with its errno (F-9)

request_body.parts.made.label: the parts of a body whose chunk failed with invalid, a value that is not UTF-8 (F-21.5), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed with header_limit, header lines of a part longer than 8192 bytes (F-23.4), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed with body_limit, a body past the body limit of 16 bytes (F-25.1), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed with value_limit, a value past the value limit of 1 byte (F-25.2), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed with part_limit, a second part past the part limit of 1 (F-25.3), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed with file_limit, a file past the file limit of 1 byte (F-25.4), give that first failure again (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with ENOENT, the kind not_found of a path that does not exist (F-10), give that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with EACCES, the kind permission_denied of a refused access (F-10), give that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with ENOSPC, the kind storage_full of a full storage (F-10), give that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
the parts of a body whose chunk failed to create its file with EIO, the kind io of a failure of the system (F-10), give that first failure again with its errno (F-9)
